marks.gloss_en: דתנן: בו ביום בא יהודה גר עמוני... אמר לו רבן גמליאל: אסור אתה -- Rabban Gamliel was in the study hall that day, ruling
שנאמר ואסיר גבולות עמים ועתודותיהם שושתי ואוריד כביר יושבים
והלא כבר נאמר לא יבא עמוני ומואבי בקהל ה' -- how can an Ammonite be permitted?
וכי עמון ומואב במקומן הן יושבין? Sennacherib mixed up the nations, and whatever separates, separates from the majority (= p_sancheriv_bilbel, p_kol_deparish)
Rabban Gamliel: you [the Ammonite convert] are forbidden to enter the congregation
והלא כבר נאמר ושבתי את שבות עמי ישראל, ועדיין לא שבו
והלא כבר נאמר ושבתי את שבות עמי ישראל, ועדיין לא שבו -- the prophecy of return does not show a return (= p_adayin_lo_shavu)
R' Yehoshua: a prophecy of return does not show they have returned -- it is also said of Israel, and they have not yet returned
נעבריה? גמירי מעלין בקודש ואין מורידין
it is a received tradition: one raises in holiness and does not lower
והלא כבר נאמר ואחרי כן אשיב את שבות בני עמון -- and they have already returned, so Ammon is in its place again
Jer 49:6: 'and afterward I will bring back the captivity of the children of Ammon, says the Lord' -- and they have already returned
his wife: perhaps they will remove you [too]
that day they removed the doorkeeper and the students were given permission to enter
four hundred benches were added
Eduyot was taught on that day
Rabban Gamliel: since that is how it is, I will go and appease R' Yehoshua
Rabban Gamliel: I have offended you, forgive me; [unheeded:] do it for the honour of my father
R' Yehoshua's message: let the one who wears the garment wear it; shall the one who does not wear it say to the one who does, 'take off your garment and I will wear it'?
R' Yehoshua at the door: let the sprinkler son of a sprinkler sprinkle; shall one who is neither a sprinkler nor son of one say to him, 'your water is cave water and your ash is oven ash'?
if two prayers were before him, mincha and musaf, he prays mincha and afterwards musaf
R' Zeira: when the Sages pass I will rise before them and receive reward
and [the prayer] of the additional offerings (musaf) [may be recited] all day
כדמתרגם רב יוסף -- his translation renders נוגי as תברא, destruction
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: whoever prays musaf after seven hours, according to R' Yehuda -- of him the verse says 'nugei from the appointed time I have gathered from you' (Zeph 3:18)
דכתיב: דלפה נפשי מתוגה -- תוגה is sorrow
מהכא: בתולותיה נוגות והיא מר לה -- נוגות alongside bitterness is sorrow
R' Elazar: whoever prays shacharit after four hours, according to R' Yehuda -- of him the verse says 'nugei from the appointed time...' (Zeph 3:18)
